scope.scientific_question: Can the frozen single-model flip score predict held-out finite-model flip frequency better than same-information margin-only calibration on untouched observations?
scope.data: UCI Adult; public nonclinical feasibility screen only

source.citation: Becker, B. & Kohavi, R. (1996). Adult [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5XW20.

analysis_unit.group_id: sha256(canonical JSON array of typed, whitespace-trimmed features; categorical '?' mapped to __MISSING__)
analysis_unit.within_group_record_weight: each raw training record receives 1 / group_record_count, so each group contributes total weight 1
analysis_unit.duplicate_test_groups: exclude every adult.data group whose feature hash appears in adult.test; never inspect the adult.test income label
analysis_unit.repeated_features: all records sharing a feature-group hash are assigned to the same split; calibration and test score each group once

partition.training_rule: SHA256(salt + newline + feature_group_sha256), interpret all 256 bits unsigned; train if 10 * digest_integer < 7 * 2^256, otherwise calibration
partition.calibration_subset_rule: sort eligible calibration groups by SHA256(salt + newline + feature_group_sha256), take first 512; if fewer, take all and report count; no refill

features.numeric_imputation: training-group median only; report learned medians
features.categorical_vocabulary: sorted unique categories learned from training groups only, with reserved missing/unknown tokens
features.categorical_encoding: integer category codes with LightGBM native categorical feature indices

models.fit_data: group bootstrap of training groups, n draws equals training group count, replacement
independent group bootstrap of training groups, n draws equals training group count, replacement

score_and_targets.logit_margin: z = logit(p_D0), requiring finite predictions strictly inside (0,1)
score_and_targets.calibration_target: mean over six INT predictions of indicator((p_INT >= 0.5) differs from (p_D0 >= 0.5))
score_and_targets.evaluation_target: mean over eleven AUDIT predictions of indicator((p_AUDIT >= 0.5) differs from (p_D0 >= 0.5))
score_and_targets.method_fit_queue: selected calibration groups with D0 alert and group weight 1
score_and_targets.evaluation_queue: adult.test feature groups with D0 alert and group weight 1; identical rows and weights for every method

fixed_order.input: D0 margin z and calibration-only KDE/variance

fixed_order.purpose: attribution diagnostic only; cannot rescue primary score failure

scale_and_kde.scale_estimator: mean over selected calibration groups of unbiased sample variance (ddof=1) across six INT logit margins; equal group weights
scale_and_kde.kde_reference: selected calibration groups' D0 margins only
scale_and_kde.query_grid: 2001 equally spaced points from min(calibration z)-1 to max(calibration z)+1
scale_and_kde.interpolation: linear interpolation on saved grid; outside range use endpoint value; report calibration/evaluation extrapolation fractions
scale_and_kde.zero_scale_or_zero_bandwidth: mark Tweedie method non-estimable, retain every other method, no floor or seed change

metrics.primary: group-weighted finite 11-AUDIT-reference Brier on one common D0-alert evaluation queue

predeclared_decision_rule.primary_score_failure_action: stop presenting frozen Tweedie score as superior if it does not beat the predeclared margin-only same-information baselines on the common held-out audit queue; post-hoc Tweedie isotonic success only supports ordinary calibration, not the raw score
predeclared_decision_rule.if_any_advantage: inspect budget, sorting, interpolation, loss and leakage; treat as a reason for a later independent multi-task replication, never as a general/ICU claim
